run_sphere: run the sphere function on a numpy array to compute sum of squared values
run_rosenbrock: run the rosenbrock function on a numpy array to evaluate the classic optimization benchmark
run_rastrigin: run the rastrigin multimodal function on a numpy array to test optimization algorithms
run_discretefunction_onemax: run the DiscreteFunction onemax variant on an array to count mismatches from the perturbed optimum
run_bonnansfunction: run the BonnansFunction callable on an array to evaluate a random least-squares objective
